def: a walking; by implication, a procession or march, a caravan

occurrences.text: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.
They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.
He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
